item.title: AutoCon4 Session Notes (Unofficial)
item.description:
These are my personal notes from the AutoCon4 and Nautocon sessions I attended. I reviewed them and created summaries while the content was still fresh in mind to try to better solidfy what I was learning.

This is not a transcript nor an official summary, just what I captured and reviewed the night after that I felt was worth remembering. I am publishing them in case they help anyone revisit ideas, catch up on sessions they missed, or get a feel for the event while we all wait for videos to come out.
